# Ghufron Ainun Najib

> Full-stack developer in Semarang, Indonesia. Web products built end to end — TypeScript, React, Node.js, Cloudflare Workers, Flutter, Laravel, PostgreSQL.

## About

Ghufron Ainun Najib is a full-stack developer and Bachelor of Applied Science in Computer Engineering student at Politeknik Negeri Semarang (Polines), graduating August 2028 (GPA 3.91/4.00). Open to opportunities.

## Projects

- [TempeMail](https://ghufronainun.tech/projects/tempe-mail): disposable email service on Cloudflare Workers. Multi-domain, REST API, webhooks, MCP server for AI agents.
- [Curated Design](https://ghufronainun.tech/projects/curated-design): searchable directory of 292 design resources for AI coding, markdown-first and open to contributions.
- [SewaInAja](https://ghufronainun.tech/projects/sewainaja): rental platform — Flutter mobile app plus Next.js 16 admin/API, Firebase and Midtrans payments, 4-person team.
- [LSP Polines](https://ghufronainun.tech/projects/lsp-polines): certification platform, Laravel + Livewire + MySQL, led a 5-person team.
- [IMPP Website](https://ghufronainun.tech/projects/impp-website): public site and CMS for Ikatan Mahasiswa Pemalang Polines, Laravel + MySQL.

## Skills

TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Cloudflare Workers, Flutter, Laravel, PHP, Python, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Firebase, Supabase, Convex, Docker, Git, Figma.
